description: The exact bytes of every signed or hashed structure. A CBOR array in fixed order, the domain tag in slot 0, RFC 8949. Any other implementation must reproduce these.
_why: A signature is over these bytes, so changing one breaks every record ever made with it, and tests that build and check with the same code stay green. Integers above 2^32-1 are CBOR uint64, never float64. Change this file only with a new tag, and keep reading the old one.

issuer_list_format._note: The root keys here are placeholders for this vector only. Nothing in production trusts them.
